scripts.prebuild: node scripts/sync-i18n.mjs && node scripts/generate-thumbs.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='../src/main/resources/static/assets';try{if(fs.existsSync(p)){const files=fs.readdirSync(p);files.forEach(f=>{try{fs.rmSync(p+'/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}});console.log('Cleaned '+files.length+' items from assets dir')}}catch(e){console.log('Warning: could not clean assets dir, continuing anyway');if(!fs.existsSync(p)){fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true})}}"
